intro: The e-Transit visa is for passing through India on your way to another country. It was added to India’s eVisa scheme in late 2025 and allows up to two entries. We complete your India e-Transit visa application and check your onward ticket.
eligibility: You are travelling through India to a third country
You have a confirmed onward ticket
You have a visa for your final destination, if it needs one
Your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the date you arrive

sections.heading: Do you need a transit visa for India?
sections.text: If you are changing planes at an Indian airport and staying airside, you may not need a visa at all. If you need to leave the airport, change airports, or stop over in India for a short time on your way somewhere else, you need a transit visa. The e-Transit visa lets you apply online instead of through a visa centre.

sections.heading: What the e-Transit visa allows
sections.text: The e-Transit visa allows up to two entries within a short validity period, so it can cover both legs of a journey that passes through India twice. It is only for transit: if you want to spend time in India as a tourist, apply for an e-Tourist visa instead.

sections.heading: India e-Transit visa documents
sections.text: You'll need a scan of your passport photo page, a recent photo with a white background, and your onward ticket showing you're leaving India for another country. If your final destination needs a visa, have that ready too, as airlines may ask for it before you board.

sections.heading: India e-Transit visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Indian eVisas for clients across the UK, entirely online. We complete your application, check every detail against your passport and keep you updated until your eVisa arrives.

description: Passing through India on the way to another country? India e-Transit visa help for UK residents, with onward ticket checks.

faqs.q: Can I visit India on an e-Transit visa?
faqs.a: Only for the purpose of transit. If you plan to spend time sightseeing or visiting people, apply for an e-Tourist visa.

faqs.q: Do I need an India e-Transit visa if I stay airside?
faqs.a: Often not. If you change planes without leaving the airport, you may not need a visa. If you need to leave the airport or change airports, you need one.

faqs.q: How many entries does an India e-Transit visa allow?
faqs.a: Up to two entries, which can cover both legs of a journey that passes through India twice.
